Seahawks vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, October 15 · NFL Week 6 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 15, 7:34 PM ET

Jaxon Smith-Njigba has the highest SPAGS projection in the Seahawks at Broncos DraftKings Showdown: 20.1 points at $11,600 FLEX, 30.2 at captain for $17,400. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba holds 75% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Smith-Njigba is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.4 points at an $11,600 FLEX salary, in a game with a 40.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 27.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Smith-Njigba at captain. Emanuel Wilson is the next captain in line, at 15.0%. The model gives him 20.4 carries and 1.8 targets.

Seattle is a 2.5-point favorite, and the implied totals are 21.5 for the Seahawks and 19 for the Broncos. Neither number describes a shootout. Both describe a game where somebody has to carry the ball.

Behind Smith-Njigba and Wilson, the next projections are Bo Nix (15.8, $9,600), Sam Darnold (15.2, $9,800) and Jaylen Waddle (10.8, $9,000).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 15, 7:34 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA WR ($11,600 FLEX / $17,400 CPT)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba holds 27.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,400 and the 20.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 8.8 targets on 25.2 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 20.1 points with a simulated floor of 8.4 and a ceiling of 39.6. He holds 75% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 27.1% as the captain and 48.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Emanuel Wilson holds 15.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,100 and the 14.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 22.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 20.4 carries and 1.8 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Wilson averaged 14.9 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 29.5. He holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 15.0% as the captain and 39.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Bo Nix, DEN QB ($9,600 FLEX / $14,400 CPT)

Bo Nix holds 13.2% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,400 and the 15.8-point SPAGS model projection becomes 23.7 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.7 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Nix averaged 15.8 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 29.1. He holds 65% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 13.2% as the captain and 51.9% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Seahawks vs Broncos

Sam Darnold, SEA QB ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Sam Darnold carries the 3rd-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 15.2 DraftKings points for a $9,800 FLEX salary ($14,700 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Darnold averaged 15.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.1 and a ceiling of 28.2. He holds 60% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.4% as the captain and 52.0% in a FLEX spot.

Jaylen Waddle, DEN WR ($9,000 FLEX / $13,500 CPT)

Jaylen Waddle carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.8 DraftKings points for a $9,000 FLEX salary ($13,500 at captain). The model gives him 7.0 targets on 27.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Waddle averaged 10.8 points with a simulated floor of 4.0 and a ceiling of 23.4. He holds 32% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.2% as the captain and 27.4% in a FLEX spot.

J.K. Dobbins carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.7 DraftKings points for an $8,400 FLEX salary ($12,600 at captain). The model gives him 14.3 carries and 1.3 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Dobbins averaged 9.7 points with a simulated floor of 4.3 and a ceiling of 18.4. He holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.2% as the captain and 23.1% in a FLEX spot.

Showdown value plays at $5,000 and under

Value: Cooper Kupp, SEA WR ($3,200 FLEX / $4,800 CPT)

Cooper Kupp projects for 6.2 DraftKings points at a $3,200 FLEX salary, 1.93 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 3.3 targets on 19.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Kupp averaged 6.2 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 19.4. He holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 2.8% as the captain and 18.7% in a FLEX spot.

Value: AJ Barner, SEA TE ($4,200 FLEX / $6,300 CPT)

AJ Barner projects for 7.8 DraftKings points at a $4,200 FLEX salary, 1.86 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 4.0 targets on 20.6 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Barner averaged 7.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.4 and a ceiling of 23.9. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 5.9% as the captain and 20.6% in a FLEX spot.

Seahawks vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown FAQ

Who is the best captain for the Seahawks vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 27.1%, ahead of Emanuel Wilson (15.0%) and Bo Nix (13.2%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Seahawks vs Broncos?

Build around AJ Barner at captain with Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Bo Nix and Sam Darnold at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (217 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $12,700 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Seahawks vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba leads the SPAGS model at 20.1 DraftKings points for $11,600 at FLEX, or 30.2 points at captain for $17,400.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Seahawks vs Broncos Showdown?

Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the most expensive player at $11,600 FLEX and $17,400 at captain. All 28 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Seahawks vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Cooper Kupp (6.2 points at $3,200), AJ Barner (7.8 points at $4,200) and Rashid Shaheed (6.1 points at $3,600).

What is the Seahawks vs Broncos spread and total?

The Seahawks are a 2.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 40.5, with implied team totals of 21.5 for the Seahawks and 19 for the Broncos.
